connection_formation_rule: A connection appears only with evidence: an independent verification receipt, a propagated lesson that changed a decision, or a handoff with a clean chain of custody. Evidence links live in both teams' ledgers.
contract_formation_rule: A contract becomes proposed when both teams' ledgers record the agreement; it becomes active when the first exchange under it completes with receipts.

how_to_join.what: Publish a Smart Ledger issue in the NayaPOWER repo: every lead/agent, area, bullseye, score. Scores move only on independent scorer receipts.
Publish the machine ledger at a canonical path (pattern: BRAIN/90-OPERATIONS/<team>-ledger.machine.json).
Wire lane feeds for sign-in/sign-out/receipts every wave.
Append one entry to this map's teams array and one section to NETWORK-MAP.md: ledger issue, ledger JSON path, average score, status.
Make the first connection: a cross-team verification, a propagated lesson, or a handoff — with evidence in both ledgers.

proof_note: Both ledger bodies read live from the GitHub API 2026-10-11. Scores are the scorecards inside the issues, verbatim. connections and contracts are empty by design: zero verified cross-team connections exist on 2026-10-11.
